def calculate_festival_date(festival_id, year, use_overrides=True):
    if use_overrides:
        try:
            from .overrides import get_festival_override

            override_date = get_festival_override(festival_id, year)
            if override_date:
                return override_date
        except (ImportError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
            pass
    rules = get_festival_rules_v3()
    if festival_id not in rules:
        return None
    return algorithmic(festival_id, year, rules)
